facts.claim: Queen Anne (Cunard): Entered service 2024; 113,998 GT; 2960 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 322 m length; Queen Anne class.
Anne-Marie is a Danish princess who was Queen of Greece as the consort of King Constantine II from their marriage on 18 September 1964 until the abolition of the Greek monarchy on 1 June 1973.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Cunard; entered service 2024; 130,000 GT; approx. 2,960 guests at double occupancy.
